description: Read early voting, absentee/mail, election-day, and provisional vote-method breakdowns alongside registered-voter, ballots-cast, and undervote/overvote turnout statistics by race and candidate from RoutPoint v2…

county_fips.description: Optional 5-digit county FIPS code (e.g. "48081", "37021") to scope returns and turnout to one county.

district.description: Optional district code filter for legislative or congressional races (e.g. "10", "11").

election_date.description: Optional election date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2024-11-05", "2026-03-03", "2026-08-18"). Defaults to the most recent covered election for the state.

include_precincts.description: When true, include per-precinct early voting, mail, election-day, and turnout breakdowns inside each race.

source_id.description: Optional 64-character SHA-256 source identifier for a specific county/state return file.

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: get_early_voting_turnout
